metadata.title: Subcontractor Risk Review
metadata.description: Scripted walk-through of the cockpit agent assembling a supplier stability readout for Q2.

steps.speaker: Escaple IA
steps.message: Hey, I need a current state report on our primary vendors supporting new product release in Q2. Can you pull the latest facts?

steps.speaker: Cockpit Agent
steps.message: Sure. I"ll run a quick stability check and collect a supplier plan to help you mitigate delivery risk this quarter.

steps.speaker: Escaple IA
steps.message: Great, let"s see risk across supplier names, product quality, and any recent stability signals.

steps.speaker: Cockpit Agent
steps.message: I"ll start now. You"ll get a narrative summary, risk classification, and follow-ups on capacity and pricing.
